en.html:
My chief trouble had not been the amount of heat spent. It was the bodily functions working at cross-purposes.
Spent heat required proper rest; there was no getting round that. To put the bodily functions right, however, I had only to settle the disturbed body and mind.

That much, during this short withdrawal from combat, I had managed.

ja.html:
不調の原因は、熱量の消耗よりも身体機能の齟齬が
大きかった。
　前者は充分な休息を取らねば回復しないが、後者は
乱れた心身を鎮静させるのみで復旧し得る。

　短い戦闘離脱時間を使い、俺はそれに成功していた。
